correctness.rationale: The only collision pairs are \(\{n-1,n\}\) for \(a\) and \(\{1,n\}\) for \(b\). After the first letter, an image always omits \(1\) or \(n\), so \(b\) cannot reduce rank again. Equality in the spacing lower bound forces \((ba)^{s-1}\); an explicit hole induction proves it works through \(s=\lceil n/2\rceil\), and the saturation pattern proves strict failure at the next deficiency. Exhaustive subset BFS for \(4\le n\le18\) and replay through \(n=200\) corroborate all claimed cases.
